lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I'll raise the oxygen concentration to the max!
Absolute assaults Behemoth, who is already reeling from the recent explosion from her head, from all angles.
An endless barrage of explosive rifle rounds and missiles detonate in quick succession.
With the heightened oxygen concentration, their power is even more heightened.
The beast which once seemed invincible is brought to her knees.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Finally, I can get a few licks in!
Anis and Neon also direct their attacks toward Behemoth.
Rapi takes a moment to glance at her broken gun,
and then grabs the box which Grave previously gave her.
Tendrils of flame belch out of the weapon.
Concentrate your fire! Let's end this!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: All the Dark Matter is gone! Its armor is stripped off!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: They don't call us Heretic Killers for nothing!
After a few moments of continuous and uninterrupted gunfire,
the maelstrom finally ceases on Emma's signal.
Her entire body has turned gray.
Slowly but surely, her body is crumbling into nothingness.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Designating... body as auxiliary computation device.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Don't, Grave! You'll suffer a Mind Switch!

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Commencing computation... based on recorded pattern.
Particles burst out from Grave's back.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I'll take you where there's the least amount of this liquid.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Our progress may be slow, and take one step at a time,

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: but we'll be on the right path.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Grave, are you saying this ability is meant to...

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: With this power, I can avoid any impending misfortune.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I can make it so that you can walk the correct path.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I can ensure that the story is written as it should be.
Leviathan anxiously watches the black sea formation she has created.
While she remains confident that no one could possibly penetrate this massive waterfall,
she is still bothered by their ability to avoid the previous wave.
Therefore, she keeps her eyes fixated on the water, not taking her eyes off it for even a second.
The flow of the liquid starts to change.
Before it, Leviathan sees Cinderella and Grave.
Slowly but surely, they walk towards it.
All it can do is watch in abject terror.
Cinderella escapes from the black waterfall.
After staggering for a few moments, she looks back,
but sees no sign of Grave.
The roar of the falling liquid is her only answer.
revealing a motionless Grave lying on the floor.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Let me take care of this real quick.
Cinderella turns back and looks at Leviathan.
Leviathan feels a terror overcome her, unlike anything she has experienced before.
With a bloodcurdling scream, she turns and attempts to run away, limping with a leg that has yet to fully regenerate.
Between the massive attacks she unleashed on Behemoth and Leviathan earlier,
along with being immersed in the black liquid for so long,
she has been pushed to her utmost limits, despite being a Heretic.
Cinderella focuses her gaze intently on the fleeing Leviathan.
Feeling her consciousness fading, she forces herself to focus.
When she's certain she has a clear shot,
she fires what she is certain is the coup de grace in this particular battle.
Off in the distance, a sprinting Leviathan is pierced by Cinderella's shot.
She falls down and claws at the ground.
Leviathan calls out to Behemoth while writhing in pain.
However, all Behemoth does is continue to slowly disintegrate.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Y-you know you don't stand a chance against us! That's why you're lying.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: There's no way Behemoth would lose to the likes of you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Get up, you idiot! I'm in pain!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You promised! We said we'd take revenge on them! That we'd strike back!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: The pain! I think I'm gonna die!
With a crumbling body that is barely held together, she staggers to her feet.
She appears as if she will turn to dust at any moment.
causing her disembodied corpse to crumble and disappear.
Her core falls to the ground with a resounding thud.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: This is all a lie. I know it.
The ground starts to shake with such ferocity
that it's hard to remain upright.
Something juts up and fills my view.
It resembles a gargantuan piece of heavy machinery.
A towering foreign object that seems as if it could trample everything in its path.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: So she could transform after all?
Retreat! We can't fight her in such cramped quarters!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Damn it! Just when we thought we'd won!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Let's get the hell out of here!
